title: A small piece of sky
context: An original fictional visual vignette; no historical event is asserted.
drawing: Flat color animation with soft closed silhouettes. People have oversized rounded heads, compact solid trunks, and broad rounded arm and leg shapes that carry visible mass. Small paddle-shaped hands and blunt feet finish the silhouette. Two upright dark pill marks are the only facial marks: no mouth, nose, brows, pupils or eye shine. Clothing covers the body normally, with no anatomy visible through fabric. Read emotion from posture, head angle and pauses. Use quiet edges and limited shading; avoid glossy toy surfaces and mechanical additions.

cast.lead: A compact plain mascot made from white filled shapes: round head, small solid torso, broad arms and legs, paddle hands and blunt feet. Two dark upright pill marks sit inside the white face. No hair, outfit, mouth, nose or eyebrows. Preserve the white body and stable proportions.

props.item: One cyan rectangular block with softly rounded corners.

exclude: Hairline arms or legs, empty ring heads, extra facial marks, cloned people or objects, anatomy showing through clothing, unrequested lettering, watermarks and brand marks.

shots.setting: A pitch-black flat canvas with no floor or simulated light. One cyan block is the only colored object.

item.place: within the black graphic field in front of the person

beats.action: A medium view leaves room above the mascot. It bends slightly toward the cyan block.
The right hand contacts the block and draws it upward as the left hand remains at the side.
The mascot holds the block at chest height and tilts its head a little; no new facial marks appear.
